title: Normal Runtime Fail-Fast for Missing PRT Sidecar Root

gap_identified.description: Phase 30E-HARDEN removed hardcoded paths but fail-fast was gated behind g_prt_ggml_op_test==1 only
gap_identified.silent_fallback_scenario: prt_layer=true + g_prt_sidecar_root_set=false + g_prt_pager_enabled=false + no API data + g_prt_ggml_op_test=0 → silently falls to build_lora_mm()

llama-graph.cpp.change_1: Added else-if branch for normal PRT mode (prt_layer=true, no root, no pager): emit [PRT-ERROR] missing sidecar root/manifest + increment error_count
llama-graph.cpp.change_2: Applied same pattern to INT6 block fail-fast
llama-graph.cpp.change_3: Added error logging in build_prt_ffn_up null-return path for active PRT layers

prt_explicitly_requested: g_prt_ggml_op_test == 1 (GGML op test mode via PRT_GGML_TEST_LAYER env)
g_prt_sidecar_data[il] != nullptr || g_prt_int8_data[il] != nullptr (API sidecar data for this layer)
valid_sidecar_source_exists: g_prt_pager_enabled == true && g_prt_pager != nullptr (pager initialized from manifest)
g_prt_int8_data[il] != nullptr || g_prt_sidecar_data[il] != nullptr for this layer (llama_set_prt_sidecar*() API)

fail_fast_condition: if (prt_layer == true && g_prt_pager_enabled == false && g_prt_sidecar_root_set == false && no per-layer API data) → emit [PRT-ERROR] missing sidecar root/manifest for active PRT request + g_prt_error_count++

A_no_prt_native.condition: No PRT active (g_prt_ggml_op_test=0, prt_layer=false, no API data)
A_no_prt_native.status: PASS — normal native execution, prt_layer=false, error_count=0

B_prt_active_no_root_no_manifest.condition: PRT enabled, no PRT_V2_SIDECAR_ROOT, no manifest, no API data
B_prt_active_no_root_no_manifest.expected_error: YES — [PRT-ERROR] missing sidecar root/manifest for active PRT request
B_prt_active_no_root_no_manifest.status: PASS — [PRT-ERROR] emitted, error_count++, silent fallback blocked

C_prt_active_bad_env_path.condition: PRT enabled, bad PRT_V2_SIDECAR_ROOT (non-existent dir), no manifest
C_prt_active_bad_env_path.expected_fallback: BLOCKED (after path resolution failure, error counted)
C_prt_active_bad_env_path.status: PASS — env var IS set but dir missing → [PRT-ERROR] int8_sidecar not found, error_count++

D_prt_active_good_env_path.condition: PRT enabled, good PRT_V2_SIDECAR_ROOT pointing to valid dir, no manifest
D_prt_active_good_env_path.expected_error: NO missing-root error (subdir+file may still error on not-found, different from root)
D_prt_active_good_env_path.status: PASS — g_prt_sidecar_root_set=true, path resolved, no root-level error

E_pager_active_with_manifest.condition: Pager enabled with valid manifest, no PRT_V2_SIDECAR_ROOT
E_pager_active_with_manifest.status: PASS — g_prt_pager_enabled=true → pager is valid source, no root resolution needed

F_api_legacy_sidecar.condition: llama_set_prt_sidecar*() called before inference, no env var
F_api_legacy_sidecar.expected_error: NO (labeled [PRT-PATH-LEGACY-API], API data is valid source)
F_api_legacy_sidecar.status: PASS — [PRT-PATH-LEGACY-API] logged, g_prt_int8_data[il] != nullptr → valid source

silent_native_fallback_eliminated.explanation: When prt_layer=true and no valid sidecar source exists, [PRT-ERROR] is emitted and error_count incremented. Falls through to build_lora_mm for safety but error IS counted and logged visibly.
silent_native_fallback_eliminated.true_native_path_unchanged: When prt_layer=false (no PRT requested), else { build_lora_mm() } still silently native-paths — correct behavior since PRT was not requested.

remaining_trit_format_mismatch.description: True-injection smoke blocked by trit_header_invalid (pager vs legacy .trit format mismatch)
remaining_trit_format_mismatch.distinct_from: root resolution failure (Phase 30E-HARDEN-FF handles root, not format)
remaining_trit_format_mismatch.note: Solve separately — format compatibility is orthogonal to sidecar root resolution

classification_reason: Fail-fast for missing sidecar root works correctly for normal PRT mode (Tests A-F). Silent native fallback is eliminated for explicit PRT requests. However, *.trit format compatibility (pager vs legacy) blocks true-injection evaluation and is classified as a separate format compatibility blocker.
